memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in activities of daily living; manages shop alone; walks unaided.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (normal); no need for further assessment.
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal fall risk).
medicines: 6 regular (amlodipine, telmisartan, methotrexate, folic acid, hydroxychloroquine, sertraline); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: PHQ-9 score 8 indicating mild depressive symptoms; continue sertraline, monitor.
carers: spouse – Priya.
goals: "I want to keep my shop open and feel less joint pain."

memories.text:

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still independent; occasional knee stiffness after prolonged standing.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable).
falls: No falls; gait mildly antalgic on right knee; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 6 regular; polypharmacy – Beers review due.
mood: PHQ-9 6 (improved); continue sertraline.
carers: spouse – Priya.
goals: "I want to walk the market lanes without pain."

memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST‑T changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No arrhythmia.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed my right knee swelling after climbing stairs; the new celecoxib helps a bit but I still feel stiffness in the mornings.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Manages shop; reports increased morning stiffness in both hands and knees.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (annual screen due next visit).
falls: One fall at home 3 months ago (tripped over rug); no injury; gait cautious; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise and supportive footwear.
medicines: 7 regular (added celecoxib); polypharmacy – Beers review.
mood: PHQ-9 8 (worsening); consider augmenting antidepressant.
carers: spouse – Priya.
goals: "I want to reduce pain and avoid another fall."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
amlodipine 5 mg OD
 telmisartan 40 mg OD
 methotrexate 10 mg once weekly
 folic acid 5 mg once weekly
 hydroxychloroquine 200 mg OD
 sertraline 50 mg OD
 celecoxib 200 mg BD
 add: mirtazapine 15 mg HS

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referred to Rheumatology, Victoria Hospital, for evaluation of persistent inflammatory arthritis despite current DMARD regimen. Requested assessment for biologic therapy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Rheumatology review: Confirmed seronegative rheumatoid arthritis. Advised to continue methotrexate, add sulfasalazine 500 mg BD, and consider TNF inhibitor if inadequate response in 3 months. Returned recommendations to primary care.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to shop; reports less hand swelling after starting sulfasalazine.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (annual screen normal).
falls: No further falls; gait improved; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (borderline).
medicines: 8 regular (added sulfasalazine); polypharmacy – Beers review.
mood: PHQ-9 5 (better); continue sertraline and mirtazapine.
carers: spouse – Priya.
goals: "I want to stay active in my shop and keep up with my grandchildren."
